main_text.p: Columnella scribit. Phil. Camerarius in medit-tion. lib. cent. 2. testatur de caseo hac vera esse, enim cum nanseaid expertum, aitq; bubali-nam carnem infustis dura esse coctionis, dulce-req; suo infipidam. Alii tanto lentore pre-dicam eam afferunt, ut in parietem adastatene-cuissime adhæreat, quæ de causa menstruat-bus abdicandam censent, idq; juratissimis affir-mant verbis. Sed forsan ventriculo silli non ma, adeo fuerunt robusto.

Bovis adulti nondum castrati, quia ad-missura servantur, tauri vocantur. Horum carnem omnium fere sententiis proscriptam re-perio atq; damnatam. Castrati autem ante ma-turam (postea enim non dibent, nam dura sunt, Varrone teste) nondum laboris fracti, mediq; ætatis, utiliores habentur, vehementer enim alit, alimentumq; quod subministrant, non facile dissipatur. Raro tamen macellum intrant, mus srure fracto, aut aliacaufa nutriles ad agricul-turam fuerint. Laudem tauroruṁ siluesse hic naturalium rerum peritiqvitio vertent, qui ob-feruarunt, licet hoc animal in libidinem admo-dum esseratum sit s concitatum, non tamen se-pius quam bovis in direfcendere, a concepta vero spiritus vacca, modestum castum, ultius nihil moliri, unde tanta in hieroglyphicis Egyptiorum temperantia s continentia suit symbolum. Quo libidinosi monentur, ut ab hoc brutæ exemplum sumentes in conjugio alienos amores non sectentur.

page.notes: Page is a two-column-style printed page with marginal and mixed text. Heavy show-through and blurring make many words doubtful; the transcription above is a best-effort reading and should be checked against the scan. Many words are uncertain and no [?] markers were applied consistently; treat the Latin as unreliable. The running head is uncertain (possibly "DE VITA"). The catchword "Tautina" is doubtful. Marginal notes on the left edge (e.g., "Tautina.") are partially legible and were not separately marked.
